entries.rationale: Named Human Design system terminology is strong evidence that the wording itself was previously encountered; it does not establish that answers were altered.
These compound labels have specific meanings in Human Design that ordinary uses of the word authority do not carry.

The defined, undefined, and open center labels are system terms; an ordinary reference to a center is handled separately as context-dependent.

The system-qualified profile wording and slash-line forms are Human Design terminology; the unqualified word profile is context-dependent.

i wait until my feelings settle
entries.rationale: These behavior-first statements may resemble broad theory descriptions but are ordinary language and must not be elevated into theory-exposure evidence.

forbidden_uses: Do not call a participant contaminated or infer causal contamination from wording.
Do not use birth data, chart features, hidden classes, predictions, scores, results, confidence, hits, or misses.
Do not change eligibility, stopping, questionnaire flow, scoring, exclusion, or the primary analysis.
Do not treat context-dependent or generic semantic resemblance as a positive theory-language signal.
Do not infer endorsement from quotation, rejection, or a report of prior exposure.
Do not treat an unsupported language as clean; record it as not adequately assessable.
Do not search social profiles, browsing histories, communities, purchases, or any source outside the collected transcript.
